comment: Entry points for the playnet OCapN gateway. Browser tries each entry in order. The sref encodes the gateway's cryptographic identity; the same sref is reused across all transports — browser splices in the discovered ws URL via ?url=. discoverGateway() also prepends a 'self' entry derived from window.location so a working ws is always available.

gateway.name: clearnet
gateway.comment: Phase A clearnet face: CDN in front of the origin.
